source.title: Mercury MESSENGER MDIS Global Mosaic 250m (May 2013)
source.credit: MESSENGER Team / Arizona State University / USGS Astrogeology Science Center

processing: USGS WMS MESSENGER_May2013 full-globe 750 nm monochrome mosaic exported at 1024x512 JPEG, EPSG:4326, without recoloring; immutable SHA-256-bound copy.
limitations: Historical 2013 750 nm reflectance mosaic with polar image fills, not natural-color or live Mercury photography.
The 1024x512 WMS/JPEG resample limits detail; the shader's simple phase mask is not calibrated surface photometry.
